description.text: The Asia Championship Series is the season of ranked Pokémon card tournaments in Asian regions outside Japan, among them Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines; a season runs from 1 September to 31 August. Players who earn enough points over a season get end-of-season rewards, among them Celebratory Fanfare with the season's Asia Championship Series logo, the card Japanese players get for their own Championship Series; recent seasons' rewards are collected at Ultra Ball League events.
